thread:
sara: PR #8210 is blocked — need a short architecture brief + RFC link before we can merge. @devin can you paste the RFC or a 2-3 line summary of SLO/rollback implications? Also will this require ops/config changes?

devin: On it. RFC: https://r.fwd/rfcs/2026/kv-prefetch-design — TL;DR: adds per-tenant lightweight prefetch to reduce tail latency for hot prefixes. Expected p95 improvement ~15% for long sequences, ~5% extra memory per shard. Rollback plan: feature flag + canary routing to disable prefetch per model/tenant. Will add RFC link & a short SLO/rollback section to the PR.

sara: Nice. Can you explicitly call out the SLO deltas and the exact config knobs ops will need? That'll make arch sign-off straightforward.

devin: Yep — updating now. Quick sample config I'll add to the PR comment:```
# prefetch config
prefetch_window: 512
prefetch_mem_limit_mb: 2048
# per-tenant enable/disable: prefetch_enabled: false
```
Also note we need a small autoscaler tweak to observe per-prefetch memory.

sam: FYI release calendar — next canary slot is tomorrow 09:30 PT. If arch signs off today and CI stays green we can roll then. @jen can you confirm test coverage + perf runs are sufficient for a canary?

jen: I reviewed the branch: unit tests + perf harness runs exist but we should add one regression for multi-tenant eviction under mem pressure. I can put a tiny test in the branch this morning.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed on branch pr/8210 (build #4521). test/perf runs queued.

sara: Great. Once RFC updated and the extra test is in, I'll ping arch for sign-off. @devin drop the RFC url in the PR description and ping me when done :thumbsup:
